survival_tips.tip: Layer 1: Thermal compression base (merino wool or polyester, avoid cotton). Layer 2: Thick fleece or wool sweater. Layer 3: Long windproof down coat (80%+ down rating, reaching knees).
Never wear flat-soled sneakers on ice. Use boots with grooved rubber soles. Walk with a 'penguin shuffle': small steps, knees slightly bent, center of gravity shifted forward.
Central heating (暖气) keeps dorm rooms at +22°C while outside is -25°C. Air humidity drops below 15%. Buy a 30 RMB ultrasonic humidifier immediately to prevent nosebleeds and dry cough.
Smartphones rapidly shut down outdoors in sub-zero weather. Keep your phone inside an inner coat pocket close to body heat with an active stick-on heat patch (暖宝宝).
